{"diagnosis": "Loopback with divider 64 sent 0xa5 but receiver returned 0xd2 (TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xd2 want 0xa5, FAIL 0xdead). Excerpt shows duplicate `0:` labels at lines 78 and 83, so state 1 half-bit wait on `2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider` is unreachable and state 1 falls to default, sampling off-phase. This corrupts `recv_pattern`/`recv_buf_data` to 0xd2. Grounding picosoc/simpleuart.v:20.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
--- a/picosoc/simpleuart.v
+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -82,5 +82,5 @@
 				end
-				0: begin
+				1: begin
 					if (2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin
 						recv_state <= 2;
 						recv_divcnt <= 0;
", "expected": "tohost PASS, TRAP gone, uart data 0xa5 matches"}
